rev.t: I planned my wedding at Temple Tree Leisure this January 2026. My wedding was a two day event and overall, we had a beyond phenomenal experience. I’d like to thank Mr. Rishi Saravanakumar and Mr. Rahul Shaji for helping us with …

Wonderful space, made our wedding unforgettable. Lush, beautiful, spacious and thougtfully laid out, Temple Tree Leisure was an amazing choice for us. There is a lot of foliage, and the venue lights really make the place pop. …
It's a nice place to conduct reception and wedding ceremony but only in the night. Only disadvantage is the access road and surrounding roads are so dirty and difficult to reach there.
